0022600108.text: The Bulls (0-1, 5th in the Central, 15th in the East) are looking for their first win, while the Wizards (1-0, 2nd in the Southeast, 5th in the East) have started 1-0. No games between these teams have been played yet this season, but Chicago won all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 119-108 win in Washington on April 9, 2026. Chicago will be without Nic Claxton (hamstring), while Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve).
